# Third-party audio: sources and licences

All files here are CC0 (public domain dedication); no attribution is required, but we credit them anyway.
The audio files themselves are not in git (see .gitignore); this list says where each came from so they can be
fetched again. Full attribution table and the cue each sound is for: docs/design/audio-plan.md.

| Folder | Source | Author | Licence | Downloaded |

| kenney_interface-sounds/ (100 .ogg) | https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | 2026-10-18 |
| kenney_rpg-audio/ (52 .ogg) | https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | 2026-10-18 |
